query:
SELECT b.id, b.booking_date, b.status, b.vessel_id, v.name as vessel_name, b.client_email, b.client_name
FROM bookings b
JOIN vessels v ON b.vessel_id = v.id
WHERE b.booking_date >= 1732752000000
ORDER BY b.booking_date DESC
LIMIT 10;
